scope: existing development partitions, continuous source trajectories, six shared participant classes
interpretation: Fixed diagnostic readouts. The CNR validation IDs share one export with training, while SUMO validation comes from separate traffic episodes. These results measure association under those splits, not causal loss of vehicle behaviour.

models.linear: balanced sample weights, train-standardized logistic regression C=1, fixed
models.nonlinear: balanced sample weights, HistGradientBoosting max_iter=100, early_stopping=False, fixed

uncertainty: Point estimates only. No tuning on validation and no independence claim for source routes.

route_neighbours.definition: 32 equidistant arc-length points, original absolute XY, directed start-to-end order

train.metric: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits of class-mean arc occupancy on the common 16x16 grid

val.metric: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits of class-mean arc occupancy on the common 16x16 grid
